title: Old Soldiers
lines: Steve is on the common floor at 2 AM, sketching the skyline.
CAP: Couldn't sleep either? The city's quiet from up here.
CAP: You know, I used to draw this skyline before the ice. Different buildings. Same light.
CAP: Tony rebuilt the Tower twice. People rebuild too. Slower, maybe.
CAP: Thanks for keeping me company. Don't tell Stark I said the Tower feels like home.
Your bond with Captain America has deepened.
